mapper.select: SELECT A.USER_NO , A.USER_EMAIL , A.USER_PASSWORD , A.USER_NAME , A.USER_REGION , A.USER_PROFILE_IMG , A.USER_PHONE , A.USER_CREATED_AT , B.ADDRESS_ID , B.ZIPCODE , B.SIDO , B.SIGUNGU , B.EUPMYUNDONG , B.ROAD_NAME , B.ADDRESS_LINE_2 , B.IS_DEFAULT , B.CREATED_AT , B.ADDRESS_LINE_1 FROM USERS A INNER JOIN USER_ADDRESS B ON A.USER_NO=B.USER_NO WHERE A.USER_EMAIL=#{username}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM USERS WHERE USER_CREATED_AT LIKE TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') || '%'
